notes:
Rocket League launch now verifies the game process, detects the selected launcher again and retries the installed launcher when a launch link does nothing.

Improved Spawner startup and reconnect waiting, optional cosmetic catalog handling for uniquely identified own loadouts, and direct online recovery after a failed auth bridge.

Item Swapper 2.0.4 checks every original backup before restoring files and prevents replacing files while Rocket League is running.

These fixes cover reproduced failure paths; affected users should still test match entry and goals.
